data.one_liner: Flutter utility for formatting, parsing and manipulating DateTime with human‑readable strings and ready‑made widgets.
data.what_it_does: Provides extensions and helpers to convert DateTime into relative, calendar and custom formatted strings. Includes parsers for natural language dates and ready‑to‑use Flutter widgets like TimeAgoText and DateBadge.
use_when: You need quick, human‑readable date strings (e.g., "2 hours ago
You want built‑in widgets that auto‑refresh date displays without extra packages.
avoid_when: Precise timezone or locale handling beyond the 16 built‑in languages is required.
strengths: Comprehensive feature set: relative time, parsing, calculations, widgets, and multi‑language support.
weaknesses: Limited to Flutter; not a pure Dart library for server‑side use.
Only 16 locales are supported out of the box.

alternatives.name: clock
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides simple time utilities and a testable Clock abstraction without UI widgets.
